name: Incendiaire
description: Porte-flamme transmettant la colère du brasier ancestral aux alliés proches qui gagnent en courage au combat.

subject.archetype: Mutant Flame Bearer - Aberrant humanoid warrior with asymmetrical torso, three arms (two atrophied, one dominant), luminescent yellow tumors across neck and shoulders, fused jaw with exposed teeth, multiple small eyes (two normal, one cybernetic), standing in aggressive combat stance

loadout.armor_outfit: Tattered ritual robes made of melted radiation blankets in dirty ochre and ash brown, crude salvaged metal plates bolted directly into mutated flesh on shoulders and chest, makeshift harness of rusted chains holding fuel canisters, collar of hollowed bone and irradiated capsule pendants around elongated neck
loadout.arsenal: Ancestral flamethrower relic - pristine geometric plasma cannon with smooth chrome plating and internal blue-violet energy core, the weapon contrasts impossibly with the wielder's decay, grafted permanently to dominant arm with metallic sutures piercing diseased flesh

attitude.behavior: Rearing back with flame projector raised high, secondary arms gripping ceremonial chains, third atrophied arm dangling uselessly, legs planted wide in intimidating stance, mouth open in guttural war cry, flames erupting from relic weapon illuminating surrounding allies with warm heroic glow
attitude.emotion: Transcendent rage channeling ancestral fury, eyes blazing with radioactive determination, expression of holy possession as they broadcast courage to nearby fighters

palette_names.name: Sickly Flesh Yellow
palette_names.role: Primary subject skin and tumor luminescence

palette_names.name: Prismatic Blue-Violet
palette_names.role: Relic weapon energy core and weapon glow

palette_names.name: Cinical Amber
palette_names.role: Flames and warm combat lighting on allies

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic low-key cinematic with volumetric flame illumination, weapon energy casting cool blue rim light on subject's left side, warm amber fire glow from front, subtle radioactive yellow ambient from tumors
color_and_light.mood: Menacing yet inspiring, sacred toxicity, brutal devotion

scenography.setting: Ravaged battlefield ruins of pre-war city, crumbling concrete structures, scattered debris of ancient war machines, makeshift altar-platform of fused bones and rusted metal as combat platform, irradiated mist in background
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Dense particulate ash falling through flame light, smoke wisps illuminated by plasma discharge, distant radioactive mist, occasional sparks from failing tech, allies silhouettes partially visible in warm flame reflection behind subject
